create_SawyerPushBackEnvV2: create a SawyerPushBackEnvV2 environment instance with default object and goal initialization parameters
run_evaluate_state: run evaluate_state on SawyerPushBackEnvV2 to compute reward and success info from observations and actions
run_compute_reward: run compute_reward to calculate grasping and in-place rewards for the push back task
run_reset_model: run reset_model to reinitialize the Sawyer push back environment with random or fixed object positions
run_gripper_caging_reward: run _gripper_caging_reward to compute the gripper caging and gripping reward signal for object manipulation
